name: Bundle Lane CI Reliability
scope: Reuse exact automatic Platform main push CI for intermediate and final coordinated-bundle states.
Dispatch one manual fallback only when no qualifying automatic run appeared, with exact required Y1 base and head inputs.
Use one shared acquisition helper for intermediate and final bundle CI.
Return structured merged_but_postmerge_verification_failed results after any completed bundle-member merge.
Clarify the existing fail-closed integration-delta dry-run exception without weakening it.
acceptance_tests: npm.cmd run check:paragraph-lane-scope -- --lane shared --base origin/main --head HEAD
forbidden: No Lesson repository or generated lesson-output change.
No product, engine, source-data, rendered-output, or Y1 evidence change.
No protected machine or external reference change.
No change to PR #208 history, authorization, or completed integration.
No merge or administrative bypass without renewed owner authorization.
